name: HieRarchical Sparse Radiance Grid (HrSRG)
definition: HrSRG is a radiance grid representation that assigns higher voxel resolution to informative 3D spaces and lower resolution to other spaces, enabling high-resolution scene description without excessive memory footprint.
summary: HrSRG is a hierarchical sparse radiance grid that adaptively allocates resolution to preserve details while avoiding trilinear interpolation and hash encoding for fast, real-time rendering.
